answer_1.quote: We investigate how the response generator influences the instruction-following capabilities of instruction-tuned LLMs... Synthetic dataset generation has emerged as a promising alternative.

answer_2.quote: We adopt two metrics to measure the performance of fine‑tuned SLMs. The first metric, used by both benchmarks, is the win rate (WR)... The second metric, used by AE2, is the length‑controlled win rate (LC). We also assess response quality using reward models and calculate the Average Reward (AR).

answer_3.quote: Both benchmarks compare responses generated by the model of interest with those generated by baselines, and employ GPT evaluators to automatically annotate which response is preferred. AE2 uses GPT‑4‑Turbo and AH uses GPT‑4‑0314 as the baselines.
